cost_billing_measurement: not measured; no paid provider called
scope: Only declared usage persisted by this synthetic run; unknown and failed requests may have unavailable usage; manual reconciliation separated; null cache is unknown, not zero
query: SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(e.result->'reconciliation','null'::jsonb) <> 'null'::jsonb AS manual_reconciliation,count(*) AS ledger_rows,sum(l.units) AS synthetic_units,sum((l.metadata->'usage'->>'input_tokens')::bigint) AS declared_input_tokens,sum((l.metadata->'usage'->>'output_tokens')::bigint) AS declared_output_tokens,sum((l.metadata->'usage'->>'cached_input_tokens')::bigint) AS declared_cached_input_tokens FROM usage_ledger l JOIN budget_reservations r ON r.id=l.reservation_id JOIN effects e ON e.id=r.effect_id GROUP BY 1) x
